verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. Rollbar says you can see which code versions are throwing exceptions (rollbar-docs-6), and deploy tracking unlocks extra debugging features (rollbar-docs-7), which loosely supports new issues per release. Item merging improves metric accuracy (rollbar-docs-4), and the REST API exposes item data that could feed external dashboards (rollbar-docs-14, rollbar-docs-15). missing for 10: documented dashboards, cross-project/team trend views, top-regression reporting, volume-over-time charts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
